_comment: Synthetic corpus for the Cairn benchmark harness (scripts/bench.py). Fictional project 'Harbor', an order-fulfilment platform. No real user memories. Keys are stable fixture ids; the server assigns the real memory ids at load time. Each record is a /remember body (SaveInput) plus `key`.

memories.title: Use Postgres SKIP LOCKED for the job queue
memories.summary: Background jobs run from a jobs table claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED instead of Redis or RabbitMQ.
memories.reason: One datastore to operate, and enqueueing is transactional with the order write.

fields.context: Needed retries and delayed jobs for fulfilment and email.
fields.consequences: Throughput is capped near 2000 jobs per second; revisit if sustained load exceeds that.

memories.title: Store money as integer minor units
memories.summary: Every amount is a bigint count of cents plus an ISO currency code; floats and decimals never cross the API.
memories.reason: Avoids drift in invoices and refunds.

fields.context: Invoice totals disagreed by a cent between the ledger and the PDF.
fields.consequences: Display formatting happens only at the edge.

memories.title: Session cookies for the web app, API keys for integrations
memories.summary: Browser users authenticate with an opaque session cookie stored in a sessions table; machine clients use hashed API keys.
memories.reason: Revocation is deleting a row; JWT revocation lists were rejected as extra moving parts.

fields.consequences: Every request does one session lookup.

memories.title: Single Cargo workspace with shared crates
memories.summary: The API, worker and CLI live in one Cargo workspace and share domain and storage crates.
memories.reason: Atomic refactors across services and one lockfile.

fields.consequences: CI must scope builds to changed crates.

memories.title: Version the public API with a date header
memories.summary: Clients pick behaviour with an Api-Version header carrying a date such as 2026-03-01, not a URL path prefix.
memories.reason: Lets breaking fixes ship per customer without duplicating routes.

fields.consequences: Each handler resolves a version at request start.

memories.title: Emit traces with OpenTelemetry and export to Tempo
memories.summary: All services use the OpenTelemetry SDK and ship spans to a Tempo instance with 10 percent head sampling.
memories.reason: Vendor neutral, and no per-host agent cost.

memories.title: Feature flags live in a Postgres table with a 30 second cache
memories.summary: Flags are rows in a flags table, cached in process for 30 seconds, edited from the admin console.
memories.reason: A team of six does not need a paid flag service.

fields.consequences: A flag change takes up to 30 seconds to apply.

memories.title: Deploy by rolling restart with a 20 second drain
memories.summary: Instances restart one at a time behind the load balancer and drain connections for 20 seconds before stopping.
memories.reason: Long-poll clients must not see dropped requests.

fields.consequences: Deploys take about eight minutes for the whole fleet.

memories.title: Admin console is a client-rendered SPA
memories.summary: The admin console ships as static files built by Vite and has no server-side rendering.
memories.reason: It sits behind login so search indexing is irrelevant, and static hosting is simpler.

fields.consequences: First paint depends on the bundle size.

memories.title: Send transactional email through the Postmark API
memories.summary: Receipts and password resets go through Postmark's HTTP API, not SMTP.
memories.reason: Delivery webhooks report bounces and spam complaints per message.

fields.consequences: Bounce webhooks need their own handler.

memories.title: Persist every timestamp in UTC as timestamptz
memories.summary: Columns are timestamptz and values are stored in UTC; conversion to a user's zone happens at the edge.
memories.reason: One representation removes daylight saving bugs from storage.

memories.title: Generate invoice PDFs with Typst templates
memories.summary: Invoices render from Typst templates compiled in process, with no headless browser.
memories.reason: Layout is reproducible and there is no browser to patch.

fields.consequences: Designers edit .typ files rather than HTML.

memories.title: Migrations must be additive in the release that ships them
memories.summary: Ship additive schema changes first and destructive ones a full release later. Drop or rename a column only one release after the code stopped using it.
memories.reason: Old instances keep running during a rolling deploy.

fields.exceptions: Emergency security fixes with the owner's sign-off.

memories.title: No unwrap or expect in request handlers
memories.summary: Map every failure to the ApiError enum. Handlers return typed errors; unwrap and expect are allowed only in tests and startup code.
memories.reason: A panic in a handler takes down the connection and hides the cause.

memories.title: Pull requests stay under 400 changed lines
memories.summary: Open a stacked series instead of one large change. Split any pull request that changes more than 400 lines of hand-written code.
memories.reason: Reviews of large diffs miss defects.

fields.exceptions: Generated code and lockfiles do not count.

memories.title: Secrets come only from the environment
memories.summary: Config files hold names of variables, not values. Credentials are read from environment variables injected at deploy time and never from committed config files.
memories.reason: Committed secrets leak through history and forks.

fields.exceptions: Local development uses an uncommitted .env file.

memories.title: Never log customer email or full card data
memories.summary: Use the redact helper before logging request bodies. Logs carry the customer id; card numbers are masked to the last four digits and emails are omitted.
memories.reason: Log pipelines are retained for 13 months and widely readable.

memories.title: Every payment POST requires an Idempotency-Key header
memories.summary: Keys are stored for 24 hours with the response body. Payment creation and refund endpoints reject requests without an Idempotency-Key header and replay the stored response for a repeated key.
memories.reason: Client retries must never charge twice.

memories.title: Integration tests use a fresh database per test
memories.summary: Never reuse a database between tests. Each integration test creates its own database from the template and drops it afterwards.
memories.reason: Shared state made tests order dependent.

fields.exceptions: Pure unit tests need no database.

memories.title: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
memories.summary: Breaking changes add an exclamation mark after the type. Use feat, fix, chore, docs or refactor prefixes with an optional scope.
memories.reason: The changelog is generated from commit prefixes.

memories.title: Remove a feature flag within 30 days of full rollout
memories.summary: Open a cleanup ticket when the rollout reaches 100 percent. Once a flag is on for everyone, delete the flag and the dead branch within 30 days.
memories.reason: Old flags multiply untested code paths.

memories.title: Public endpoints must declare a rate limit class
memories.summary: The router refuses to start when a public route has no class. Every route exposed without authentication names a limit class: strict, standard or bulk.
memories.reason: Unthrottled endpoints were abused for scraping.

memories.title: API requests hang for 30 seconds under load
memories.summary: Requests stall because the connection pool of ten is exhausted by a long report query.
memories.reason: Reports ran on the shared pool.

fields.symptom: API requests hang for 30 seconds and then time out during the morning report run.
fields.cause: A long report query holds a connection while the pool maximum is ten.
fields.fix: Run reports on a separate pool of two connections with a 15 second statement timeout.

memories.title: Customers charged twice after webhook retries
memories.summary: A slow acknowledgement made the payment provider retry the webhook and the handler booked the charge again.
memories.reason: The webhook handler was not idempotent.

fields.symptom: Some accounts show a double charge a few seconds apart.
fields.cause: The provider retries when our 200 response is slower than its timeout.
fields.fix: Record each event id in webhook_events and ignore an id seen before.

memories.title: Container crashes with exec format error on Apple laptops
memories.summary: The CI image was built for amd64 only so it cannot start on arm64 machines.
memories.reason: Developers pull the CI image for local debugging.

fields.symptom: docker run prints exec format error on an M-series Mac.
fields.cause: The build produced a single linux/amd64 image.
fields.fix: Build with buildx for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 and push one manifest list.

memories.title: Daily revenue report is off by one day for Sydney
memories.summary: The report groups orders by UTC date, so evening orders in Sydney land on the previous day.
memories.reason: Reports ignored the account time zone.

fields.symptom: Sydney merchants see yesterday's revenue under today's date.
fields.cause: Grouping used date_trunc on the UTC timestamp.
fields.fix: Group by date_trunc in the account's time zone using AT TIME ZONE.

memories.title: CI builds take 25 minutes after a dependency bump
memories.summary: The build cache key hashed Cargo.toml but not Cargo.lock, so bumps restored a stale cache.
memories.reason: Lockfile changes did not invalidate the cache.

fields.symptom: Every pipeline recompiles all dependencies after a version bump.
fields.cause: The cache key was derived from Cargo.toml only.
fields.fix: Key the cache on a hash of Cargo.lock.

memories.title: Deploy stalls for minutes during a migration
memories.summary: Adding a NOT NULL column with a default to the 40 million row orders table took an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
memories.reason: The rewrite blocked every read and write.

fields.symptom: The release hangs and requests queue behind the migration.
fields.cause: ALTER TABLE rewrote the table under an exclusive lock.
fields.fix: Add a nullable column, backfill in batches, then add the constraint as NOT VALID and validate it separately.

memories.title: Admin console blocked by CORS only in staging
memories.summary: The staging load balancer strips headers from OPTIONS responses so browsers reject the preflight.
memories.reason: The proxy rewrote responses before the app's headers reached the browser.

fields.symptom: Browser console shows a CORS error on every request from the admin console in staging, never locally.
fields.cause: The balancer answers OPTIONS itself without the allow headers.
fields.fix: Pass OPTIONS through to the app and let it set the Access-Control headers.

memories.title: Signed upload URLs rejected as expired
memories.summary: A container clock ran six minutes fast, so freshly signed storage URLs looked expired to the bucket.
memories.reason: Signature timestamps are validated by the object store.

fields.symptom: Uploads fail with RequestTimeTooSkewed within seconds of signing.
fields.cause: The host had no time synchronisation daemon.
fields.fix: Enable chrony on the hosts and monitor clock offset.

memories.title: Order ids show trailing zeros in the web client
memories.summary: Ids above 2^53 lose precision when parsed as JavaScript numbers.
memories.reason: The frontend parsed ids with JSON.parse.

fields.symptom: Order ids displayed in the console end in many zeros and do not match the database.
fields.cause: JavaScript numbers are doubles with 53 bits of integer precision.
fields.fix: Serialise every id as a string.

memories.title: Health check times out during PDF generation
memories.summary: CPU-heavy PDF rendering ran on the async runtime thread and starved other tasks.
memories.reason: Typst compilation is synchronous.

fields.symptom: The load balancer marks instances unhealthy whenever invoices are rendering.
fields.cause: Blocking work on a Tokio worker thread.

memories.title: Billing tests fail on the last day of the month
memories.summary: Proration tests read the real clock so month length changed their expected values.
memories.reason: Tests depended on the date they ran.

fields.symptom: Red builds on the 28th to 31st that pass the next day.
fields.cause: Direct calls to the system clock.
fields.fix: Inject a Clock trait and freeze it in tests.

memories.title: Duplicate and missing rows between order list pages
memories.summary: Offset pagination sorted by created_at alone is unstable when several rows share a timestamp.
memories.reason: Ties have no defined order between queries.

fields.symptom: The same order appears on two pages while another never appears.
fields.cause: ORDER BY created_at with ties and OFFSET.
fields.fix: Use keyset pagination on the pair (created_at, id).

memories.title: Cut a production release
memories.summary: Bump the version, update the changelog, tag, let CI build, promote through staging, then production.
memories.reason: Keeps releases repeatable.

steps: Bump the workspace version
Generate the changelog from commits
Tag vX.Y.Z and push the tag
Wait for CI to publish the image
Deploy to staging and run the smoke suite
Promote the same image to production
Watch error rate for 15 minutes

memories.title: Rotate the database password
memories.summary: Create the new credential, roll the application, then revoke the old one.
memories.reason: Rotation must not cause downtime.

steps: Create a second database role with the same grants
Update the secret store with the new role
Roll the API and worker deployments
Confirm no connections use the old role
Drop the old role
fields.when: Quarterly or after a suspected leak.

memories.title: Restore the database from a backup
memories.summary: Restore a point-in-time copy into a scratch instance, verify it, then copy rows back or promote it.
memories.reason: Never restore over production directly.

steps: Pick the recovery target timestamp
Start a scratch instance from the base backup
Replay WAL to the target time
Verify row counts and recent orders
Copy the missing rows back or promote the scratch instance

memories.title: Add a database migration
memories.summary: Create a numbered SQL file, test it on a copy of production data, and ship it ahead of the code.
memories.reason: Migrations run before instances roll.

steps: Create migrations/NNNN_name.sql
Make it additive
Run it against the staging snapshot
Open the pull request with the plan for the destructive follow-up

memories.title: Onboard a new merchant
memories.summary: Create the account, issue sandbox keys, verify the webhook endpoint, then enable live mode.
memories.reason: Support follows one checklist.

steps: Create the merchant in the admin console
Issue sandbox API keys
Send a test webhook and confirm a 200
Review the merchant's tax settings
Enable live mode

memories.title: Roll back a bad deploy
memories.summary: Redeploy the previous image, disable new flags, and confirm the error rate recovers.
memories.reason: Rollback is faster than a forward fix.

steps: Announce the rollback in the incident channel
Redeploy the previous image tag
Turn off flags added in the release
Check the error dashboard
File the post-incident review
fields.when: Error rate above 2 percent after a release.

memories.title: Rebuild the search index
memories.summary: Create a new index concurrently, backfill it, swap the alias, and drop the old index.
memories.reason: Search stays available during the rebuild.

steps: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY with the new definition
Backfill documents in batches
Switch the read alias
Drop the old index after a day

memories.title: Set up a local development environment
memories.summary: Install the toolchain, start Postgres in Docker, run migrations and seed demo data.
memories.reason: New engineers are productive on day one.

steps: Install rustup and Node 22
docker compose up -d postgres
cargo run -p harbor-cli -- migrate
cargo run -p harbor-cli -- seed
npm install and npm run dev in the console folder
fields.when: Joining the team or after a laptop change.

memories.title: Production region layout
memories.summary: Primary compute and the writer database are in Frankfurt; a read replica serves reporting from Ireland. Production runs in eu-central-1 with a read replica in eu-west-1.
memories.reason: Latency and residency requirements.

memories.title: PostgreSQL version and extensions
memories.summary: Major upgrades are scheduled yearly in the spring. The platform runs PostgreSQL 16 with the pgcrypto and pg_trgm extensions.
memories.reason: Needed for compatibility checks.

memories.title: Public API service level objectives
memories.summary: The error budget is about 43 minutes per month. The public API targets 99.9 percent monthly availability and p95 latency under 300 milliseconds.
memories.reason: Alerts are derived from these targets.

memories.title: Data retention periods
memories.summary: Deletion jobs run weekly on Sundays. Order records are kept seven years and audit logs thirteen months.
memories.reason: Accounting law and security policy.

memories.title: Payment providers
memories.summary: Each provider has its own webhook endpoint and secret. Card payments go through Stripe and bank debits through GoCardless.
memories.reason: Integration code is split per provider.

memories.title: On-call rotation
memories.summary: The primary and secondary engineers are listed in the paging tool. On-call rotates weekly with handover on Mondays at 10:00 CET.
memories.reason: Everyone should know who is paged.

memories.title: Attachment upload limit
memories.summary: Larger files must use the multipart upload endpoint. Uploads are limited to 25 MB per attachment.
memories.reason: Protects memory on the API instances.

memories.title: VAT rate source
memories.summary: A failed sync keeps yesterday's rates and raises an alert. VAT rates come from a nightly sync of the European Commission TEDB service.
memories.reason: Rates change without notice.

memories.title: Default local ports
memories.summary: All ports are configurable through environment variables. The API listens on 8080, the console dev server on 5173 and metrics on 9102.
memories.reason: Avoid port clashes in local setups.

memories.title: CI platform and duration
memories.summary: Cold cache runs take about 25 minutes. CI runs on GitHub Actions with four-core runners and a full pipeline takes about nine minutes with a warm cache.
memories.reason: Sets expectations for review turnaround.

memories.title: Refund endpoint is half done
memories.summary: Validation and ledger entries are written; the provider call and tests remain.
memories.reason: Work paused at the end of the day. Next: call the provider refund API with the idempotency key, then add integration tests for partial refunds. Unresolved: whether refunds over 90 days need approval.

memories.title: Search move to pg_trgm in progress
memories.summary: The trigram index is built in staging; relevance needs comparing with the old engine before cutover.
memories.reason: Cutover depends on a quality check. Next: replay 500 recorded queries against both engines and diff the top five. Unresolved: typo tolerance threshold.

memories.title: Merchant onboarding wizard steps one to three done
memories.summary: The first three wizard steps are implemented; the identity verification step is blocked on legal wording.
memories.reason: Waiting for legal. Next: build step four once the copy is approved. Unresolved: which countries need document upload.

memories.title: Checkout latency regression traced to tax lookup
memories.summary: p95 checkout time rose after the tax lookup moved inline; a cache design is drafted but not implemented.
memories.reason: Fix needs a decision on cache invalidation. Next: implement an in-process cache keyed by country and rate date. Unresolved: invalidation after the nightly VAT sync.

memories.title: Session: order list pagination fix
memories.summary: Switched the order list to keyset pagination on created_at and id and added a regression test with tied timestamps.
memories.reason: Closing summary of a working session. Touched src/orders/list.rs and tests/orders_list.rs. The OFFSET variant was removed.

memories.title: Session: tracing exporter set up
memories.summary: Configured the OpenTelemetry exporter; spans appear in Tempo with ten percent sampling.
memories.reason: Closing summary of a working session. Touched src/telemetry.rs. Sampling is set through an environment variable.

memories.title: Session: invoice template drafted
memories.summary: Wrote the first Typst invoice template with embedded fonts; right-to-left customer names still render in the wrong order.
memories.reason: Closing summary of a working session. Touched templates/invoice.typ and src/billing/render.rs.

memories.title: Session: web framework upgrade
memories.summary: Upgraded axum to 0.8, rewrote path parameter syntax and got the whole test suite green.
memories.reason: Closing summary of a working session. Touched Cargo.toml and every router module.

memories.title: Amounts are stored in cents
memories.summary: Formatting for display is done by the client. Money fields are bigint cents with a currency code, with no floating point in the API.
memories.reason: Avoids precision mistakes.

memories.title: Requests freeze when the database pool runs out
memories.summary: A slow reporting query keeps a connection and the ten-connection pool is exhausted so requests hang.
memories.reason: Reports shared the main pool.

fields.symptom: API calls hang about half a minute under morning load.
fields.cause: Long query holds one of ten pooled connections.
fields.fix: Give reports their own small pool with a statement timeout.

memories.title: Payment requests need an idempotency key
memories.summary: Store keys for a day together with the response. Refund and payment creation calls without an Idempotency-Key header are rejected, repeated keys return the stored response.
memories.reason: Prevents a retried request from charging twice.

memories.title: Payment webhooks replayed and booked twice
memories.summary: When our acknowledgement is slow the provider replays the webhook and the charge was booked a second time.
memories.reason: Handler lacked deduplication.

fields.symptom: Double charges seconds apart on one account.
fields.cause: Provider timeout shorter than our response time.
fields.fix: Store processed event ids and skip repeats.

memories.title: Expand then contract for schema changes
memories.summary: Destructive changes ship one release later. Add new columns first; remove or rename old columns only in the release after code stops using them.
memories.reason: Instances on the old version run during a rolling deploy.

fields.exceptions: Security emergencies approved by the owner.

memories.title: Keep personal data out of logs
memories.summary: Run request bodies through the redact helper. Log the customer id only; mask card numbers to four digits and leave emails out.
memories.reason: Logs are kept for 13 months and many people can read them.

memories.title: Team offsite venue shortlist
memories.summary: Decision on the venue is due at the end of the month. Three venues are shortlisted for the autumn offsite: a lakeside lodge, a city loft and a mountain hut.
memories.reason: Planning note.

memories.title: Office coffee machine descaling
memories.summary: Use the citric acid packs in the kitchen cupboard. The office coffee machine is descaled on the first Friday of every month.
memories.reason: Facilities note.

memories.title: Public holiday calendar for the Berlin office
memories.summary: Holiday dates are in the shared calendar. The Berlin office observes nine public holidays in 2026 plus a company day after Christmas.
memories.reason: Planning note.

memories.title: Laptop refresh policy
memories.summary: Requests go to the IT desk. Company laptops are replaced after 36 months of use.
memories.reason: Hardware policy.
